'''Fi-Ek Sirch''' was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Wielding a [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]],<ref name="Saga" /> he was one of many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] chosen as part of the [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]]<ref name="Chee" /> led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to rescue [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. During the fighting, which came be known as the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] and the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Sirch was likely [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="Chee" />

==Behind the scenes==
A toy of the character labeled "Nikto Jedi Knight," was released by [[Hasbro]] in [[2002]]. An updated version of the figure was released, using the character's name, in [[2011]].
